title: eludite.project.properties input
description: Project > Properties (Alt+Enter on a project in the Workspace window, or a double-click on it): the project property pages as a document tab (`open`), or, for an agent, their values. Answers Visual Studio's ~30 properties people touch (the catalog in host-rpc.md, "Project properties": Application, Build, Package, Code Analysis) evaluated by eludite-host in one configuration and platform, each with where its value comes from: the project file (`project`), a conditioned property group (`conditioned`), an imported file such as Directory.Build.props (`inherited`, with `inherited_from`), or the SDK's default (`default`). Change one with eludite.project.set_property; launch profiles (the Debug page) are eludite.project.launch_profiles.

project.description: The project: its name as the Workspace window shows it, or the path of its project file (absolute, or relative to the solution folder). Default: the project selected in the Workspace window, else the active document's project, else the startup project.

configuration.description: The project configuration (`Debug`, `Release`, or the project's own). Default: the one the Solution Configurations list's selection maps the project to.

platform.description: The project platform (`AnyCPU`, `x64`, `x86`, `ARM64`; `Any CPU` is read as `AnyCPU`). Default: the one the Solution Platforms list's selection maps the project to.

framework.description: A target framework of a multi-targeted project (`net8.0`). Default: none (the outer evaluation; for `set_property`, no framework condition).

page.description: Only this page's properties (and, with `open`, the page shown).

open.description: Open (or activate) the project's Properties document tab, as Project > Properties does. Default false.
